model.name: editorToolbar.historyBackRegression
model.description: History back-navigation on RbEditorToolbar — historyBack (window.history.back → the correct previous view) + pathLabelNav (navigate to the containing folder) — is a PROTECTED behaviour pinned by an EXECUTING regression gate: verifies BEHAVIOUR @390 on a real device (tap Back lands on the correct previous view; path-label nav resolves), pixel/behavioural never a DOM count, stub-must-fail (break historyBack → RED), registered in gate:device:live. Covers BOTH toolbar nav handlers so any refactor that drops either eager call goes RED (the music-player/S23-audio silent-regression lesson made structural).
